items: Rhodes frozen rolls (brown bag), 7-8 rolls per bender
Set rolls out to thaw the morning of, or refrigerate the night before.
Roll thawed dough into a rectangle shape.
Roll a ruler down the dough and cut each side 1/4 of the way in on the ruler marks.
Fill center with cheese, pepperoni, olives, etc.
Criss-cross dough and pinch together at center.
Rise dough on sprayed cookie sheet, covering each bender with sprayed plastic wrap.
